newsitem.title: USA: Maine revenues above projections in January.
newsitem.headline: Maine revenues above projections in January.

text.p: State revenues were one percent ahead of projections in January, giving Maine a $35 million surplus on the fiscal year, the governor's office said Wednesday.
Individual income tax collections were seven percent above projections in January, but business income tax collections were 67 percent below estimates for the month, state officials said.
Sales tax collections were eight percent behind estimates while the gross receipts tax was off by nine percent.
Income from investments was 149 percent higher than expected, according to the governor's office.
Maine has collected $1.1 billion in undedicated revenues in the first seven months of the fiscal year, three percent more than projected, officials said.
The state's fiscal year starts July 1.
